tweets.title: INDIA–US SPECIAL FORCES CONDUCT JOINT COUNTER-TERROR DRILL IN PUNE The National Security Guard (NSG), alongside the U.S. Army Special Forces, conducted a high-intensity counter-terror mock drill at the Infosys Phase-2 Campus in Hinjawadi IT Park, Pune. - Over 100 NSG "Black Cat" commandos and 17 U.S. Special Forces personnel participated. - Teams slithered from Indian Air Force Mi-17 helicopters onto multi-level parking structures as part of the exercise. - The drill was conducted solely to test emergency response and preparedness protocols. Authorities confirmed there was no actual security threat to the Infosys campus or the public. Video Courtesy: PTI
tweets.content:
INDIA–US SPECIAL FORCES CONDUCT JOINT COUNTER-TERROR DRILL IN PUNE

The National Security Guard (NSG), alongside the U.S. Army Special Forces, conducted a high-intensity counter-terror mock drill at the Infosys Phase-2 Campus in Hinjawadi IT Park, Pune.

- Over 100 NSG "Black Cat" commandos and 17 U.S. Special Forces personnel participated.

- Teams slithered from Indian Air Force Mi-17 helicopters onto multi-level parking structures as part of the exercise.

- The drill was conducted solely to test emergency response and preparedness protocols.

Authorities confirmed there was no actual security threat to the Infosys campus or the public.

Video Courtesy: PTI

Pakistan is expanding its maritime reach into the Bay of Bengal; marking a strategic push toward India’s traditionally secure eastern seaboard.

tweets.title: Indian Army Floats Tender for 2,715 Logistics Drones The Indian Army has issued an RFI for 2,715 logistics drones to strengthen last-mile resupply in high-altitude areas, including Siachen, the Line of Control (LoC), and the Line of Actual Control (LAC). Requirements: 🔹 Three variants for operations from 6,000 ft to 20,000 ft 🔹 Capable of operating in temperatures from +50°C to -30°C 🔹 Equipped with GPS + NavIC, thermal imaging, obstacle avoidance, anti-jamming features, and IFF (Identification Friend or Foe) 🔹 Deployable by a 2–3 member crew with a minimum 7-year service life The procurement is aimed at reducing dependence on helicopters and manual porters for supplying troops deployed in remote Himalayan posts, while improving logistics in challenging terrain.
tweets.content:
Indian Army Floats Tender for 2,715 Logistics Drones

The Indian Army has issued an RFI for 2,715 logistics drones to strengthen last-mile resupply in high-altitude areas, including Siachen, the Line of Control (LoC), and the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

Requirements:
🔹 Three variants for operations from 6,000 ft to 20,000 ft
🔹 Capable of operating in temperatures from +50°C to -30°C 🔹 Equipped with GPS + NavIC, thermal imaging, obstacle avoidance, anti-jamming features, and IFF (Identification Friend or Foe) 🔹 Deployable by a 2–3 member crew with a minimum 7-year service life

The procurement is aimed at reducing dependence on helicopters and manual porters for supplying troops deployed in remote Himalayan posts, while improving logistics in challenging terrain.

Iran says it has reached an understanding with Oman on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, with a joint statement reportedly in its final drafting stage.

- A framework has been agreed on route parameters

- Talks are still ongoing, and no final agreement has been signed

- Tehran says the process could be derailed if "third parties" intervene

While the development could pave the way for easing disruptions in the vital shipping lane, key details remain unresolved, and the U.S. has previously opposed any arrangement that would give Iran control over access to the strait.
